title: The Eclipse Prayer | Dr. Omar Suleiman
description:
There was an eclipse on one of the most painful days of the Prophet ﷺ's life. He reminded the ummah about the eclipse prayer.

How to pray Salat al-Kusuf (the eclipse prayer):

It's 2 rak’ahs, prayed in congregation if possible. No adhan or iqamah.

In each rak’ah: Recite Surah al-Fatihah + a long surah, then a long ruku, then rise and recite al-Fatihah + another surah again, then bow a second time, then go into sujood as normal. So each rak’ah has 2 standings, 2 bowings, and 2 prostrations.

After the prayer, it's sunnah to give a khutbah reminding people of Allah's power, as the Prophet ﷺ did. 

Beyond the prayer, it's sunnah to make du’a and dhikr until the eclipse ends, give charity, and seek Allah’s forgiveness.
